about.power_confirm_reboot: Reboot the whole device? It goes quiet for a minute or two.
about.power_lead: Restart the voice services if the device has stopped answering. Rebooting restarts the whole device and takes a minute or two to come back.
about.power_confirm_note: You will be asked to confirm first.
